module.name: RaitOrg
module.description: Organizacao do orgao julgador: calendario de feriados ([WF-RAIT-002] secao 7; UC-RAIT-043 fluxo 1), atos de suspensao de prazo por forca maior (UC-RAIT-022), folha de jeton por periodo (UC-RAIT-036), incidente de prescricao operacional ([WF-RAIT-002] secao 4.1 e 4.2), amostra de qualidade (UC-RAIT-025), plano de capacidade ([WF-RAIT-004] secao 8; UC-RAIT-038) e exportacoes com controle LGPD (UC-RAIT-042). Parametros vivem em ops.parameter (ADR-0021 Decision 6): este blueprint nao define rait_parameter e nenhuma coluna guarda valor de parametro.

entities.name: RaitHoliday
entities.description: Feriado ou ponto facultativo do calendario do orgao — [WF-RAIT-002] secao 7 (calendario nacional + estadual do AM, decisao do Owner A.6) e UC-RAIT-043 fluxo 1 e AC-RAIT-043-3. Porta de calendario do motor de prazos; unicidade por data e escopo levanta RAIT.CALENDAR_OVERLAP (catalogo de erros secao 3.9).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_holiday_scope
checks.expression: scope in ('nacional','estadual','municipal')

entities.name: RaitSuspensionAct
entities.description: Ato motivado de suspensao de prazo por forca maior — UC-RAIT-022 (fluxo 1 a 4, fluxos 1a e 2a) e [WF-RAIT-002] secao 7. Prova obrigatoria (evidence_document_id; RAIT.SUSPENSION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED) e ato assinado (signed_by); prazos de extincao nao podem ser suspensos (RAIT.SUSPENSION_LEGAL_TIMER, guarda de comando porque depende do codigo do timer). Os timers e casos alcancados apontam para o ato por inf.infraction_timer.suspended_by_act_id e inf.rait_deadline.suspended_by_act_id (decisao M5).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_suspension_act_state
checks.expression: state in ('vigente','revogado','encerrado')

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_suspension_act_period_order
checks.expression: ends_on >= starts_on

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_suspension_act_timer_codes_array
checks.expression: jsonb_typeof(timer_codes) = 'array'

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_suspension_act_review_complete
checks.expression: reviewed_at is null or reviewed_by is not null

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_suspension_act_revoked_complete
checks.expression: state <> 'revogado' or (revoked_at is not null and revoked_reason is not null)

entities.name: RaitJetonSheet
entities.description: Folha de remuneracao por sessao (jeton) por periodo e orgao colegiado — UC-RAIT-036 fluxo 1 a 4 e fluxo 3a. Estados minusculos derivados do proprio UC (decisao M12): gerada, conferida pela secretaria, homologada pelo presidente, enviada ao RH/financeiro; RAIT.JETON_ALREADY_APPROVED barra a reaprovacao e RAIT.JETON_MINUTES_UNSIGNED a sessao sem ata assinada. source_pending marca que rait.jeton.value e rait.jeton.monthly_cap seguem pendentes de fonte (steering H.54 e H.57; ADR-0021 Decision 2, RAIT.PARAMETER_SOURCE_PENDING).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_sheet_body
checks.expression: judging_body in ('jari','cetran')

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_sheet_state
checks.expression: state in ('gerada','conferida','homologada','enviada')

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_sheet_period_order
checks.expression: period_end >= period_start

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_sheet_review_complete
checks.expression: state = 'gerada' or (reviewed_at is not null and reviewed_by is not null)

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_sheet_homologation_complete
checks.expression: state not in ('homologada','enviada') or (homologated_at is not null and homologated_by is not null)

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_sheet_sent_complete
checks.expression: state <> 'enviada' or sent_at is not null

entities.name: RaitJetonLine
entities.description: Linha da folha de jeton: um membro em uma sessao com ata assinada — UC-RAIT-036 fluxo 1 (presenca valida, itens relatados, votos, faltas justificadas e injustificadas), fluxo 2 e 2a (teto mensal, sessao excedente nao remunerada) e AC-RAIT-036-1 a AC-RAIT-036-3. unit_value e amount existem e ficam nulos enquanto source_pending for verdadeiro, porque rait.jeton.value nao tem fonte (steering H.54 e H.57).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_line_absence_kind
checks.expression: absence_kind is null or absence_kind in ('justificada','injustificada')

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_line_absence_exclusive
checks.expression: absence_kind is null or not attendance_valid

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_line_counts_non_negative
checks.expression: items_reported >= 0 and votes_cast >= 0

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_line_remunerated_needs_attendance
checks.expression: not remunerated or attendance_valid

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_jeton_line_value_pending
checks.expression: (source_pending and unit_value is null and amount is null) or (not source_pending and unit_value is not null and amount is not null)

entities.name: RaitIncident
entities.description: Incidente de prescricao operacional — [WF-RAIT-002] secao 4.1 e 4.2 (nivel PRESCRITO_OPERACIONAL: registro de incidente, apuracao de causa, comunicacao ao LEGAL/auditoria) e AC-RAIT-010-4. incident_ref no formato INC-AAAA-NNNN, o mesmo de inf.rait_clock_alert.incident_ref (fixture INC-2026-0007, rait-fixtures.md secao 3). outcome e texto livre porque nenhuma fonte fixa vocabulario de desfecho (mesmo tratamento de rait_pool_member.jurisdiction).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_incident_target
checks.expression: clock_id is not null or case_id is not null

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_incident_closed_complete
checks.expression: closed_at is null or (responsible_id is not null and cause_analysis is not null and outcome is not null)

entities.name: RaitQualitySample
entities.description: Item da amostra de qualidade das decisoes do periodo — UC-RAIT-025 (fluxo 1 sorteio estratificado, fluxo 2 checklist com achados tipados, fluxo 3 achados sistematicos ao TEAT e a JARI, fluxo 2a sem reabrir decisao) e [WF-RAIT-004] secao 2.1 fila F-DP-Q. O percentual da amostra e o parametro rait.quality.sample_pct (ops.parameter, ADR-0021): nenhuma coluna o guarda. Os tokens de finding_kind sao os quatro itens do checklist do fluxo 2 (decisao de modelagem M12).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_quality_sample_period_order
checks.expression: period_end >= period_start

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_quality_sample_finding_kind
checks.expression: finding_kind is null or finding_kind in ('fundamento','prova','coerencia','linguagem')

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_quality_sample_finding_needs_review
checks.expression: finding_kind is null or reviewed_at is not null

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_quality_sample_systemic_needs_finding
checks.expression: not systemic or finding_kind is not null

entities.name: RaitCapacityPlan
entities.description: Plano de capacidade por pool e periodo — [WF-RAIT-004] secao 8 (chegada, capacidade escalada, fila e gatilho de nova turma) e UC-RAIT-038 (fluxo 1 a 4, AC-RAIT-038-1 e AC-RAIT-038-2). months_over_capacity registra os meses observados de fila acima da capacidade; o limiar e o parametro rait.unit.queue_over_capacity_months (ops.parameter) e a guarda de constituicao de turma e de comando (RAIT.UNIT_TRIGGER_NOT_MET, catalogo secao 3.10).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_capacity_plan_period_order
checks.expression: period_end >= period_start

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_capacity_plan_counts_non_negative
checks.expression: (arrival_estimate is null or arrival_estimate >= 0) and (capacity_estimate is null or capacity_estimate >= 0) and (queue_observed is null or queue_observed >= 0) and months_over_capacity >= 0

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_capacity_plan_closed_needs_measure
checks.expression: closed_at is null or measures is not null or reinforcement_requested

entities.name: RaitExport
entities.description: Exportacao de decisoes e estatisticas com controle LGPD — UC-RAIT-042 fluxo 3, fluxo 3a e AC-RAIT-042-2 (finalidade, escopo, solicitante e hash registrados; aprovacao do DPO na exportacao nominal em massa). purpose nao admite nulo (RAIT.EXPORT_PURPOSE_REQUIRED) e o limiar de linhas que exige o DPO e o parametro rait.export.dpo_threshold_rows (ops.parameter; RAIT.EXPORT_DPO_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, catalogo secao 3.11). Estados minusculos derivados do proprio UC (decisao M12).

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_export_status
checks.expression: status in ('solicitada','aguardando_dpo','gerada')

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_export_row_count_non_negative
checks.expression: row_count is null or row_count >= 0

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_export_dpo_complete
checks.expression: dpo_approved_at is null or dpo_approved_by is not null

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_export_content_hash_format
checks.expression: content_hash is null or content_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

checks.name: ck_inf_rait_export_generated_complete
checks.expression: status <> 'gerada' or (generated_at is not null and content_hash is not null and document_id is not null)
